aiResearchSummary.text: Ordinary Seafood is researching food products that include bound astaxanthin, as described in the title 'Complexed astaxanthin undergoing a hypsochromic shift upon heating.' The abstract details methods for altering food properties, such as color, by changing the binding state of astaxanthin. This work highlights their focus on developing plant-based seafood alternatives with modifiable sensory attributes.
